description: Run the earliest scheduled event of a cron hook now, like `wp cron event run`: a recurring event moves to its next slot, a single event is unscheduled, then the hook fires (404 if not scheduled). Returns next_run_timestamp (null for a single event). Audit-logged. cvrt-mcp-endpoints 1.16.0+; older versions leave the event due.
name: mcp_run_cron
